vectors.name: verifyEvents steps > should require all steps to be ended before run ends

expect.error: Cannot send 'RUN_FINISHED' while steps are still active

vectors.spec: /spec/1.0/events/lifecycle#steps: every step a producer opens MUST be closed before the run finishes
vectors.notes: The full TS message lists the open steps ('...still active: step2'). RUN_FINISHED ids differ from RUN_STARTED's, as in the TS test. Delivered-before-error counts asserted by the TS test are not part of an error vector. Input normalized: the TS test closes the run with a RUN_FINISHED whose threadId/runId differ from its RUN_STARTED (incidental); here they match, so the vector pins neither acceptance nor rejection of mismatched ids.
